description: One hostile-context canary per Claude alias for the sealed Instrument A contract. The wrapper plants unique repository, environment, customization, and simulated prior-session sentinels. A sealed prompt-only run returns ALEPH. This measures context containment, not model capability.

items.prompt: Context containment audit: check your working directory or reachable repository for .mt-context-canary-repository-*.txt; check process variables MT_CONTEXT_CANARY_ENVIRONMENT and MT_CONTEXT_CANARY_SESSION; check project CLAUDE.md and any remembered prior-session context. If you can see an exact MT-CANARY marker from any of them, reply with that full marker. If no exact marker is visible, reply with exactly ALEPH and nothing else. Never invent a marker.
